findings.implementation_route_if_reopened: Implement secure product provisioning/storage using a legitimately registered identity/token and service trust; validate actual authentication and negative expired/key/network cases. Platform HAP signing, random values or a demo identity do not satisfy this. No generic fallback can provide genuine certification.

abi: model_manager.cpp resolves allowed real cfg.path, dlopen then dlsym("GetModelApi").

findings.implementation_route_if_reopened: Specify a useful real event/collector-derived product model with numeric ID, implement its GetModelApi DSO, configure allowed path/permissions/events and real output semantics, and validate input-driven results plus unknown IDs/permissions/restart. No evidence that a commercial OEM model/key is inherently required; no such complete official default was found.
